assumptions.description: The company launches in France with a 600k EUR initial budget and a two-year execution horizon.
The first operating model is sales plus project management with certified installer partners before any large in-house installation team is built.
The first commercial focus is households and small businesses, while agricultural projects remain a later expansion track.

uncertainties.description: Final legal form, insurance package, and certification sequencing still require local professional validation before incorporation.
uncertainties.impact: Medium risk of execution delay if treated as settled.
uncertainties.mitigation: Use the launch pack as operating guidance and validate incorporation, insurance, and compliance details with local counsel and certified partners.

uncertainties.description: Internal installation should only be added after the sales funnel, partner quality, and gross margins are stable over repeated projects.
uncertainties.impact: Medium risk of premature fixed-cost expansion.
uncertainties.mitigation: Keep the first 24 months focused on distribution, project control, and a partner network with measured quality gates.
